approach: The rms speed scales with the square root of the absolute temperature, so scale the given speed by the square root of the temperature ratio.

steps.text: Apply the rms speed and temperature relation to find the new speed.

common_mistakes.text: Dividing by the square root of the temperature ratio instead of multiplying, using 50/1.1 instead of 50 × 1.1, which gives about 45 ms⁻¹ instead of 55 ms⁻¹.
Using the Celsius values 77 and 150.5 directly instead of converting both to kelvin before taking the square root.
